metadata.method: Manual structured transcription of web-tool text from two official PDFs; generated six-tier rows from printed proportional amounts.
metadata.citation_scope: Citations identify original filenames and printed figures/pages. They do NOT assert those originals exist locally. Local evidence is in sources/*web-extract.txt.
metadata.amount_semantics: base_play_amount_usd is the source column amount, not necessarily the board cost. Prizes are gross payouts, before subtracting cost.
metadata.odds_semantics: Preserve source denominators as printed, including rounded values; do not interpret them as exact probabilities.

modes.description: Use consecutive scheduled drawings across the four draw times.
Use consecutive drawings at one selected draw time.

play_types.name: Straight
play_types.match_rule: All four digits must match in their selected positions.

play_types.name: Box
play_types.match_rule: The multiset of four digits must match; order does not matter.

play_types.name: Straight/Box
play_types.match_rule: An exact match pays both components; another ordering pays only the Box component.
play_types.wager_semantics: The published base-play amount is staked on EACH component. Board cost is twice that amount before Fireball.

play_types.name: Combo
play_types.match_rule: Buy each distinct ordering as a separate Straight play on the same ticket.

play_types.name: Pairs
play_types.match_rule: Match the two selected digits in order at the selected pair positions.

rules.description: One extra digit is drawn after each Daily 4 drawing.
Form four candidate results by replacing one drawn digit at a time with Fireball; never replace several positions at once.
Count successful replacement positions separately, even when they produce identical digit strings.
Evaluate base and Fireball prizes separately. Fireball can win without a base win; when both win, add their payouts.

rules.description: Use the published Fireball rate for each winning replacement, rather than the base-game prize.
For Straight/Box, count and pay Straight and Box replacement hits separately, then add them.
Evaluate all four replacements for Pairs, including replacements outside the selected pair; those can retain a winning pair.

special_cases.qualification: Derived combined maximum for one Straight board at a $1 base play with Fireball; not a $1 total-cost ticket or a maximum across all wager tiers.
